conclusions.text: Exact source identity and names for all 17 issue IDs reproduce from the retained 2020 geoBoundaries source; this supports a stable historical identity crosswalk, not territorial correctness.
The MDB 2021 served roster identifies 16 scoped Category B local municipalities and Nelson Mandela Bay as Category A; completeness of detached territory remains unresolved.
The current legal/effective footprint after confirmed 2024 MDB determinations cannot be established without the specific Section 23 notices and an authoritative current boundary source.
The Dr AB Xuma/Engcobo legal name history and effective date need a gazetted naming instrument.
Seven source-parent Cacadu members map to present MDB Sarah Baartman (DC10), while source labels/IDs should remain preserved pending hierarchy review.
Nelson Mandela Bay has metropolitan Category A tier; current same-name hierarchy repetition needs separate engineering review.
MDB 2026 geometry is prospective on the evaluation date and is not a current replacement input.
All 33 2021-versus-prospective 2026 returned geometries differ, but the area comparison cannot identify the authoritative/current limits or explain each difference.

limitations: MDB geometry responses are exact served REST responses, not the original MDB shapefile bytes.
MDB current legal-effective date after 2024 decisions is unresolved; 2026 source explicitly prospective on 2026-10-06.
Official gazette PDFs for determinations were not retained; restore from cited official URLs and inspect pages/maps.
Detached/island feature completeness has not been proved.
Geometry differences for municipalities without cited decisions are unexplained; no boundary is selected or approved.
This manifest validates recorded bytes and methods, not geographic truth, legal currentness, redistribution rights, deployment or historical import.
